title: AG60203: Geo-Informatics For Land And Water Resources
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Electromagnetic spectrum; Energy interactions; Platforms and remote sensing
sensors: Photographic camera, scanners, earth resources satellites, active and
passive microwave sensors; Digital image processing: Image rectification, image
enhancement, image classification and accuracy; Image interpretation;
Introduction to GIS; Map Projections and Coordinate Systems; GIS Data Formats:
Vector and raster data, TIN; GIS Data Input: digitizing, remote sensing, field
data and GPS; Spatial Analysis: Vector and raster analysis, measurement, query,
statistical surfaces (DEM); Accuracy and Errors; GIS Output: Map functions in
GIS, map design and elements; GPS Fundamentals: GPS system, accuracy and
sources of error in GPS.
Case Studies: RS and GIS application in land and water resources systems.
